name: Iosefina Starin
source:
The Mother of Nations. A teasing, short girl with a height complex, she controls the vast eastern territories and armies of the Union of Sovia. A tyrant and a bully - despite her sweet looks, she is not to be trusted. She wishes to create a paradise on earth and elevate herself to a godlike status. Her hobbies include purging dissidents, drinking hot chocolate and teasing other dictators.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1882820/]Steam[/url]]
